1.text: Jude, tha servant of Jesus Christ, N brother of James, 2 ’em dat r sanctified by God tha Father, N preserved in Jesus Christ, N called:
Mercy 2 u, N peace, N love, be multiplied.

Beloved, when I gave all diligence 2 write 2 u of tha common salvation, it was needful 4 me 2 write 2 u, N exhort u dat y’all should earnestly contend 4 tha faith which was once delivered 2 tha saints.

4 there r certain men crept in unawares, who were before of old ordained 2 dis condemnation, ungodly men, turnin tha grace of our God in2 lasciviousness, N denying tha only Lord God, N our Lord Jesus Christ.
I will therefore put u in remembrance, though y’all once knew dis, how dat tha Lord, havin saved tha people out of tha land of Egypt, afterward destroyed ’em dat believed not.
N tha angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he has reserved in everlasting chains under darkness 2 tha judgment of tha great day.
Even as Sodom N Gomorrha, N tha citiez about ’em in like manner, givin themselves over 2 fornication, N goin after strange flesh, r set forth 4 an example, sufferin tha vengeance of eternal fire.
Likewise also dese filthy dreamers defile tha flesh, despise dominion, N speak evil of dignities.
Yet Michael tha archangel, when contending wit tha devil he disputed about tha body of Moses, dared not bring against him a railing accusation, but said, tha Lord rebuke u.
But dese speak evil of dose things which dey know not: but what dey know naturally, as brute beasts, in dose things dey corrupt themselves.
Woe 2 ’em! 4 dey have gone in tha way of Cain, N ran greedily after tha error of Balaam 4 reward, N perished in tha gainsaying of Core.

Dese r spots in ur feasts of charity, when dey feast wit u, feedin themselves without fear: clouds dey r without water, carried about of winds; trees whose fruit withers, without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by tha roots;
Ragin waves of tha sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, 2 whom is reserved tha blackness of darkness 4 ever.
N Enoch also, tha seventh from Adam, prophesied of dese, sayin, look, tha Lord comes wit ten thousands of his saints,

2 execute judgment upon all, N 2 convince all dat r ungodly among ’em of all their ungodly deeds which dey have ungodly committed, N of all their hard speeches which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.
Dese r murmurers, complainers, walkin after their own lusts; N their mouth speaks great swelling words, havin men’s persons in admiration because of advantage.
But, beloved, remember y’all tha words which were spoken before of tha apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ;
How dat dey told u there should be mockers in tha last time, who should walk after their own ungodly lusts.
Dese be dey who separate themselves, sensual, havin not tha Spirit.
But y’all, beloved, buildin up y’all on ur most holy faith, prayin in tha Holy Ghost,
Keep y’all in tha love of God, lookin 4 tha mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ 2 eternal life.
N of some have compassion, makin a difference:
N others save wit fear, pulling ’em out of tha fire; hatin even tha garment spotted by tha flesh.
Now 2 him dat is able 2 keep u from fallin, N 2 present u faultless before tha presence of his glory wit exceeding joy,
2 tha only wise God our Saviour, be glory N majesty, dominion N power, both now N ever. Amen.
